articles.title: pnpm 12.20
articles.summary: pnpm 12.20.0 records the specifiers of local directory dependencies in the experimental v13 lockfile and fixes several nodeLinker: hoisted , peer dependency, and overrides bugs. The bundled node-gyp no longer ships the undici version that security scanners flag. Remote resolution and shared build caches no longer work with pnpr 0.1.0-alpha.19 or older. Minor Changes With lockfile.format: v13 , pnpm install records the dependency specifiers of local directory packages. articles.title: @apollo/server@5.5.2
articles.summary: Patch Changes #8232 1766981 Thanks @glasser ! - Constrain the @graphql-tools/schema , @graphql-tools/merge , and @graphql-tools/utils dependency ranges so that a fresh install of @apollo/server on Node.js v20 (via npm) no longer pulls in @whatwg-node/promise-helpers@2 , which declares engines.node >=22.15 and therefore fails installs that enforce engine constraints (such as npm --engine-strict ). While Node.js v20 is EOL, Apollo Server 5 is still documented as supporting this version.
